describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing lateral profile against a plain off-white background, standing on four limbs with its body held low to the ground. It has a pale, smooth, rounded head with large dark eyes and a slightly smiling mouth, six feathery reddish-pink external gills projecting from the sides of the neck, a low elongated trunk covered dorsally by large overlapping dark brown scales and ventrally by highly wrinkled pale pink skin with transverse folds, four short thick wrinkled pink legs ending in broad five-toed clawed feet, and a thick tapering tail that extends to the left and is cropped by the edge of the image. The overall appearance combines a soft, naked-skinned ventral body and limbs with a heavily armored scaly back.

describe.description: A quadrupedal creature shown in right-facing profile with a pale pink wrinkled axolotl-like body and head covered on the back by a dense coat of dark brown overlapping pangolin-like scales. It stands on four short thick pink legs with clawed toes, has a smooth rounded head with large dark eyes and a slight smile, and feathery pink-red external gills fanning out behind the head. The arched scaly back sits over a ribbed pale underbody, and the rear of the body is cropped out of the frame on the left.
